## Publication

- Title: Trilateration-based indoor localization utilizing the matrix
  completion method by probabilistic matrix factorization and stochastic
  gradient
- Journal: International Journal of Information Technology (Springer Nature,
  Scopus Q2), published April 2024, Vol 17, pp. 5577-5590
- Authors: Md. Nahidul Alam, Rafiul Haider, Imam Hossain Pipul, Fahim ul Haque
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1007/s41870-024-01857-3
- Note: Final thesis project. RSSI-based positioning that fills gaps from
  missing or noisy data, more reliable than KNN in obstructed rooms.
